attributes.description: Every remaining form answer, keyed by the tenant's own question text, plus `_raw_metadata` at rest.

confirmation.description: Whether the worker confirmed the declaration on the form.

control_measures_required.description: Control measures the screening identified as required.

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

fatigue_self_assessment_score.description: The fatigue self-assessment value, where the form carries one.

financial_period.description: The accounting period the screening falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

form_id.description: The Assignar form-template id (87, 430, 211 for the three title patterns), the stable twin of `form_title`.

form_title.description: The matched Assignar form's title — which screening instrument this fact is.

occurred_at.description: When the screening record was submitted; the event time and the retention clock start.

project.description: The project the screening was recorded against, where the source gives one.

screened_on.description: The screening's own date where the form states one (the reader's `date` answer / `diary_date` fallback).

source_system.description: Originating system; `ASSIGNAR` today and the only system column the frozen universe names.

worker.description: The worker the screening is about; the required subject anchor.
